treatmentJourney.title: Comprehensive Consultation
treatmentJourney.description: Your journey begins with a thorough consultation, including full records, CBCT scans, and detailed photography, to accurately assess your oral health and understand your unique restorative needs.

treatmentJourney.title: Foundation Phase
treatmentJourney.description: This stage involves any necessary preparatory work such as extractions, implant placement, or gum and bone grafting, establishing a strong foundation for your new restorations.

treatmentJourney.title: Provisional Restorations
treatmentJourney.description: Temporary restorations are placed to allow us to test and refine the aesthetics, function, and bite, ensuring comfort and proper integration before the final prosthetics are made.

treatmentJourney.title: Custom Lab Fabrication & Delivery
treatmentJourney.description: Your final permanent restorations are meticulously crafted in a lab, then precisely delivered and fitted to achieve optimal comfort, function, and a beautiful, lasting smile.

treatmentJourney.title: Long-Term Maintenance
treatmentJourney.description: To protect your investment, we provide guidance on long-term care, including custom nightguards, regular hygiene visits, and protective measures to maintain your oral health for years to come.

faqItems.question: Why should I choose a prosthodontist for my full mouth restoration needs?
faqItems.answer: A prosthodontist specializes in the restoration and replacement of teeth, undergoing extensive training beyond dental school. This expertise is crucial for complex cases involving widespread damage, wear, or loss, ensuring a comprehensive and successful rehabilitation of your bite and smile.

faqItems.question: What types of complex dental issues do you address?
faqItems.answer: We focus on a wide spectrum of advanced dental problems, including extensive tooth wear, multiple failing restorations, missing teeth, and the need for complete mouth reconstruction. Our goal is to restore health, function, and aesthetics using modern dentistry.

faqItems.question: Will my full mouth restoration look natural?
faqItems.answer: Absolutely. We strive to recreate the natural beauty and function of your teeth through a blending of art and science. Our custom restorations are designed to integrate seamlessly with your facial features, resulting in a smile that is both healthy and aesthetically pleasing.

faqItems.question: How do you ensure the longevity of my dental work?
faqItems.answer: Our focus is on providing durable, high-quality restorations built to last. We emphasize comprehensive treatment planning and utilize advanced materials and techniques. We also provide guidance on long-term maintenance to help you retain a healthy dentition throughout your lifetime.

faqItems.question: Do you offer solutions for missing teeth?
faqItems.answer: Yes, implant dentistry is a core service we provide. We strategically use implants to anchor crowns, bridges, or full-arch prosthetics, offering comprehensive solutions for patients with missing teeth as part of a unified reconstruction plan.

faqItems.question: How can I schedule a consultation to discuss my complex dental needs?
faqItems.answer: We invite you to contact our office by phone or complete the appointment request form on our website to schedule a comprehensive consultation. This allows us to assess your specific situation and discuss the best approach for your restoration.

doctor.name: Dr. Robert B. Watkins
doctor.bio: Dr. Robert Watkins brings decades of expertise to advanced aesthetic, restorative, and implant dentistry. A graduate of Brown University and UCSF School of Dentistry, he further specialized in Prosthodontics at the Veteran Administration Medical Center. Dr. Watkins is an esteemed assistant clinical professor at UCSF's Graduate Prosthodontic Residency Program and a member of several professional organizations, including the American College of Prosthodontists. His philosophy centers on recreating natural beauty and function through a blending of art and science, assisting each patient in maintaining a healthy, functional, and esthetically pleasing dentition throughout their lifetime.
